{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:15.120
    | text      = In the world of independent standup, you generally run into two kinds of shows.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:19.680

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:28.480

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:22.080

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:24.799

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:35.120

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = bit dramatic here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:43.200
    | text      = So apparently Rex has decided to start his own little show called The Gray Area.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:47.840
    | text      = It's an interesting choice because his first attempt at a show was called I'm Not Bragging,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:52.159
    | text      = which was a line that he stole from his dad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:54.720
    | text      = Alex would regularly say I'm not bragging when he was very obviously bragging, so his
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:59.279
    | text      = son made a show with the name that was making fun of that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:02.720
    | text      = That was an attempt at capturing some kind of a Gen Z audience with Trump content, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:07.759
    | text      = now the worm has turned a little bit and the Gen Z folks don't like Trump so much anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:13.039
    | text      = To attract them, it's important to be a little bit more jaded and less interested in
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:17.200
    | text      = party politics, kind of like Alex pretended to be back when he was Rex's age.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:21.360
    | text      = Weird.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:22.159
    | text      = And thus we have The Gray Area, the space between black and white.

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:45.600
    | text      = to have worked for a decade.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:46.799
    | text      = I don't believe so either.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:47.919
    | text      = Alex might be breaking some child labor laws.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:50.240
    | text      = Well, I mean, there's definitely probably something where I bet, and I'm just going
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:54.879
    | text      = to go out on a limb and say that his relationship with his father is probably not the healthiest
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:59.759
    | text      = one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:00.480
    | text      = I'm just going to go reach for the stars on my guesses and just say that that's probably
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:06.559
    | text      = not going to be a good environment to raise a child in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:08.879
    | text      = And we all wrestle with our parents.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:11.840
    | text      = We all have struggles.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:13.120
    | text      = Absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:13.919
    | text      = We don't all need to do this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:16.080
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:18.159
    | text      = You know, there's something I don't...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:20.639
    | text      = Listen, maybe this isn't popular.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:22.960
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:23.440
    | text      = But I think there's a certain sort of person who's trying to be too big, who should not
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:29.039
    | text      = be allowed to have kids.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:30.240
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:30.559
    | text      = You know, like you shouldn't be Michael Jordan's kid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:33.039
    | text      = You just shouldn't be his kid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:34.799
    | text      = There's no win.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:35.919
    | text      = There's no way you can do anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:38.000
    | text      = It makes me think of, you know, Roy Jones Jr., the boxer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:41.360
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:41.679
    | text      = He had that album, Roy Jones Jr. Round One, the album.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:45.840
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:46.559
    | text      = And he had a song called Y'all Must've Forgot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:49.120
    | text      = That was a single on the radio.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:50.639
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:51.120
    | text      = It was about how you must've forgot how good of a boxer he was.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:52.960
    | text      = They must've forgot how good of a boxer he was.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:54.480
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:55.039
    | text      = And a lot of it was just about how he knocked people out and stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:59.600
    | text      = He was good at that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:00.399
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:01.039
    | text      = There's a line in it, though, that is like, will there be another Roy Jones?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:04.080
    | text      = Probably not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:04.799
    | text      = I stopped Virgil Hill with a body shot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:06.639
    | text      = Y'all must've forgot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:08.159
    | text      = And he has a son that's Roy Jones III.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:12.240
    | text      = You can't have that mentality if you're a singular person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:16.320
    | text      = Nope.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:17.039
    | text      = If you're a great, you can't have a kid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:19.360
    | text      = Yeah, I think it's that extension.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:21.600
    | text      = And the part of it is like, if you're that crazy great, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:25.519
    | text      = There's no way that you don't at least a little bit view your kid as an extension of how great you are.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:31.039
    | text      = Right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:31.279
    | text      = Because everything is about how great you are.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:33.120
    | text      = And no matter how well you do at trying to fight that back,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:36.559
    | text      = you're going to imprint that on the kid somehow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:39.200
    | text      = Yeah, it's not possible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:40.159
    | text      = Because even if you don't, there's the entire world that says you do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:45.360
    | text      = Even if Michael Jordan was the best father, every time that kid is outside of Michael Jordan's house,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:50.720
    | text      = they're like, you're Michael Jordan's kid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:52.720
    | text      = So Owen's on and he's wrestling with some of the big questions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:59.679
    | text      = Is it bad now?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:01.120
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:02.720
    | text      = We can't tell.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:03.360
    | text      = We're trying to decide.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:04.159
    | text      = This is the gray area, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:05.360
    | text      = Talk about the theme of the show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:07.600
    | text      = We're trying to decide if this is really worse than it's ever been.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:12.639
    | text      = Like, is this really as bad as it's ever been?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:15.279
    | text      = Or does it just feel that way because we had such high hopes for this Trump administration.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:21.840
    | text      = We went through so much to get here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:24.480
    | text      = I mean, we went through so much to get here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:27.039
    | text      = And now it feels like we've been totally betrayed, to put it simply.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:30.559
    | text      = So it's like, is it really that bad?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:32.480
    | text      = Is it really worse than it's ever been?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:33.840
    | text      = Or does it just kind of feel that way because of the betrayal
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:36.720
    | text      = and because of all the work it took to get here?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:39.600
    | text      = But regardless, the result is the same.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:41.679
    | text      = An easy answer to Owen's question is that it's definitely as bad as it's ever been
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:45.679
    | text      = and that he wasn't betrayed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:47.759
    | text      = It's as bad as it's ever been, not because things are actually as bad as they've ever been.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:52.480
    | text      = Like, other periods of history have been demonstrably worse,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:55.200
    | text      = but none of them are happening right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:58.159
    | text      = Things are as bad as they've ever been because we don't know how this plays out,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:01.600
    | text      = but we do know that things are bad and they're heading in a bad direction.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:05.839
    | text      = The past has already happened and we can see the effects of past bad times
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:09.279
    | text      = and do our best to learn from them,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:10.720
    | text      = but our present is uniquely dangerous because we don't know what's going to happen
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:14.799
    | text      = and we don't know what the consequences of today's actions are going to be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:18.880
    | text      = And Owen wasn't betrayed, except by himself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:22.079
    | text      = No one who treated Trump realistically is at all surprised by what he's doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:26.319
    | text      = It might be a little more brazen than some people expected,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:29.039
    | text      = but everything is in line with who he was from day one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:32.960
    | text      = Owen was a fine sports broadcaster who dreamed of something bigger,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:36.400
    | text      = and in 2015 he saw the easiest shortcut to those dreams
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:39.839
    | text      = in the form of bullying people at protests.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:42.880
    | text      = It was so easy, and he got a job at Infowars that paid him way more
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:46.960
    | text      = than he'd be getting at a local station doing sports,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:49.599
    | text      = which realistically is probably what he'd end up doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:52.880
    | text      = He has some skills, so maybe he could have gotten on ESPN
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:56.160
    | text      = or some other big name in sports broadcasting,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:58.640
    | text      = but it's also a competitive field, so luck is going to come into it,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:02.079
    | text      = and maybe he never would have gotten his break.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:04.400
    | text      = That beard's never going to get you on ESPN.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:06.319
    | text      = He probably would trim it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:07.599
    | text      = I'm just saying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:09.359
    | text      = In working for Infowars and going along with everything he promoted for years,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:13.359
    | text      = Owen made a deal with the devil.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:15.359
    | text      = He got to be way richer than he had any business being,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:18.000
    | text      = and he got to have a career in what felt like media.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:20.880
    | text      = What was asked in return was that he promote the party line,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:24.160
    | text      = which was Trump fanaticism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:26.640
    | text      = The disappointment Owen feels with Trump now isn't real disappointment with Trump.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:31.200
    | text      = It's a disappointment that the fake version of Trump
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:33.440
    | text      = he made a career off selling doesn't exist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:36.240
    | text      = It's a disappointment that the game is kind of over,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:38.720
    | text      = because it was a fun, easy game for them to play for the last decade.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:43.119
    | text      = That's something that I think is so critical,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:45.039
    | text      = and why these kind of people can't be trusted ever again.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:48.480
    | text      = They weren't just wrong to be optimistic about Trump.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:51.680
    | text      = If that were the case, then you could easily say,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:54.000
    | text      = man, we all get things wrong sometimes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:56.079
    | text      = It's not a crime to have hope.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:01.039
    | text      = But they weren't optimistic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:02.880
    | text      = They lied.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:04.319
    | text      = They were optimistic that they'd get away with lying,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:06.799
    | text      = and that it wouldn't blow up in their faces.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:08.799
    | text      = But they straight up lied to their audience for years
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:11.440
    | text      = in order to make the audience feel optimistic about Trump.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:15.200
    | text      = Until there's some accounting of how they lied to sell Trump in the past,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:19.119
    | text      = you can't possibly think that anything Owen is saying now
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:22.319
    | text      = isn't just another lie that's meant to sell what he thinks
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:25.119
    | text      = is his best shot at a new marketable brand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:28.160
    | text      = So yeah, your gray area is what cares.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:33.279
    | text      = I mean, it's just absurd on its face,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:35.200
    | text      = because for all of these people who are somehow like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:39.680
    | text      = ah, I feel betrayed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:41.519
    | text      = Have I been?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:42.559
    | text      = If you go back in time to 2016,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:46.319
    | text      = and you just say, let's make a deal, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:49.359
    | text      = I'll support Trump.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:50.799
    | text      = But if he ever violates the Constitution
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:54.319
    | text      = to the point where you have to say he violated the Constitution,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:57.920
    | text      = then he's done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:58.480
    | text      = He's out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:59.039
    | text      = He's dead to you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:00.480
    | text      = He's dead to all of us, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:02.240
    | text      = They would, of course, made that deal,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:03.920
    | text      = because no matter what, even if he had violated the Constitution,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:06.880
    | text      = they would have been like, I can lie my way through it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:10.160
    | text      = They would never have guessed that they would get to the point
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:13.200
    | text      = where they would say, that motherfucker's violating the Constitution.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:16.799
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:17.119
    | text      = They never thought that they would get to the point where they were worried.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:19.599
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:20.880
    | text      = About maintaining their brand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:22.720
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:23.039
    | text      = And because they are here, and because they never thought they would be here,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:26.319
    | text      = they're way willing to go as far, you know, like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:29.599
    | text      = is it as bad as it's ever been?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:30.960
    | text      = What are you fucking talking about?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:34.160
    | text      = That you're asking that question is the answer to that question.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:37.599
    | text      = To Alex Jones's son and guy who does a show with Alex Jones's son.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:42.240
    | text      = Right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:42.880
    | text      = Who I have no idea who he is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:45.759
    | text      = Yeah, I can't imagine how you would.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:46.640
    | text      = I have no strong feelings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:48.640
    | text      = So they get to complaining and talking about how Trump
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:52.880
    | text      = seems to be kind of doing dictator-type propaganda.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:56.000
    | text      = Wow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:56.559
    | text      = That's no good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:57.359
    | text      = Wow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:57.920
    | text      = And I don't know if you saw this, but Trump put out a video,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
